fieldValues.body:
- 55997a62 and 84d873ce were moved to proposed on 2026-10-28 (srs-programme PR, this conversation); c7a8e0a2 was left to the session that made it.
- The status field duplicates the lifecycle and can disagree with it; nothing checks that they agree.
- 2026-11-03: recurred with D1-D3 after remedy 06404989 was written; the second half of the gap is placement: a decision for a session must also be a member of the SemanticOps decision log (7fa3525e), and nothing in record create or the decision shape says so.
